meta.description: The lookup table for schedule presets - currently static reference data (not built from any event), same pattern as ProjectColourPaletteView. 'scheduleId' is the stable key stored on CreateProject/ProjectCreated. Exact recurring time windows live in ScheduleTimeSlotsView (one row per weekday the schedule is active), keyed by this same scheduleId - alwaysActive is the only exception, for the 'Any Time' preset which has no windows at all. FUTURE: once custom schedules are supported, both this view and ScheduleTimeSlotsView stop being static config and become event-sourced (folding e.g. ScheduleCreated/ScheduleTimeSlotAdded) instead - CreateProject.scheduleId and ProjectCreated.scheduleId will not need to change shape when that happens, only these two lookups' source.
